bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'DEBUGAI_HOST_READBACK_BEGIN\n'
printf 'HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'BRANCH='; git branch --show-current
printf 'DIRTY='; if [ -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)" ]; then echo NO; else echo YES; fi
printf 'ROLE_MODE='; docker exec debug-ai-debug-ai-1 printenv DEBUG_AI_ROLE_EXECUTION_MODE 2>/dev/null || echo NOT_VERIFIED
printf 'GATE_MODE='; docker exec debug-ai-debug-ai-1 printenv DEBUG_AI_CORE_GATE_DISPATCH_MODE 2>/dev/null || echo NOT_VERIFIED
printf 'DEBUGAI_HOST_READBACK_END\n'
